issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Construct Computer
products.tagline: Your AI coworker gets a computer. You get your day back.
products.summaryZh: 你的AI同事有了一台电脑，你的一天就回来了。
products.descriptionZh: 面向独立创始人和小团队的AI劳动力。任何MCP或技能都像应用一样安装，代理构建尚不存在的工具，由平台部署和管理，可共享给整个团队，你喜欢的任何代理操作都能转化为可复用工作流，让代理少思考、多执行。
products.description: AI workforce for solo founders and small teams. Any MCP or skill installs like an app, agents build the tools that don't exist yet, deployed and managed by the platform, shareable to the whole team, and any agent action that you like turns into a reusable workflow so agents spend less time thinking and more time doing.

products.name: FetchSandbox MCP
products.tagline: The MCP that proves your AI's integration fixes work
products.summaryZh: 证明你的AI集成修复有效的MCP
products.descriptionZh: 你的代理集成修复通过了CI。但数据仍然错误。FetchSandbox MCP在你的代码上复现了真实故障，修复了它，并证明修复有效。一份凭证，而非感觉。70多个API沙箱。在Cursor或Claude Code中只需一个配置块。
products.description: Your agent's integration fix passes CI. The data is still wrong. FetchSandbox MCP reproduces the real failure on your code, fixes it, and proves the fix held. A receipt, not a vibe. 70+ API sandboxes. One config block in Cursor or Claude Code.

products.name: OpenLogi
products.tagline: A local-first alternative to Logitech Options+
products.summaryZh: 罗技Options+的本地优先替代方案
products.descriptionZh: Logitech Options+ 的原生本地优先替代方案，使用 Rust 编写。通过 HID++ 重新映射按键、调整 DPI 和 SmartShift——无需账户，无遥测。
products.description: A native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust. Remap buttons, drive DPI and SmartShift over HID++ — no account, no telemetry.

products.name: Claude Academy
products.tagline: The Official Learning Hub by Anthropic
products.summaryZh: Anthropic官方学习中心
products.descriptionZh: 掌握完整的Claude技术栈——从基础提示词和AI素养，到构建复杂的多智能体工作流。Claude Academy将自定进度课程、开发者教程和官方认证路径整合于一个互动学习环境中。前往academy.claude.com开始学习！
products.description: Master the entire Claude stack—from basic prompting and AI fluency to building complex multi-agent workflows. Claude Academy brings self-paced courses, developer tutorials, and official certification paths into a single interactive learning environment. Start learning at academy.claude.com!

products.name: Yatko
products.tagline: The download button Github forgot to add
products.summaryZh: GitHub忘记添加的下载按钮
products.descriptionZh: Yatko（yatko.app）将任意公开的GitHub仓库转换为干净的下载链接，根据访问者的操作系统和架构自动选择正确的发布资产。只需更换域名——一键直达正确的二进制文件。
products.description: Yatko (yatko.app) turns any public Github repo into clean download links that pick the right release asset for each visitor's OS and architecture. Swap the domain — one click to the right binary.

products.name: Plask
products.tagline: Have little ducks show how deep you dive on your Apple Watch
products.summaryZh: 让小鸭子展示你在Apple Watch上的潜水深度。
products.descriptionZh: Plask将你的Apple Watch变成一座微型水下剧场：像素风橡皮鸭会随你下潜而潜入水中，屏幕上显示你的真实深度，还有一只或十只鸭子。升级至高级版，你将解锁鲨鱼、尼斯湖水怪、漂流者、鲱鱼罐头等更多内容。
products.description: Plask turns your Apple Watch into a tiny aquatic theatre: pixel-art rubber ducks that dive when you do, your real depth on screen, and a duck or ten. With premium, you get sharks, the Loch Ness-monster, a castaway, surströmming, and more.

products.name: Tab Notes
products.tagline: Turn your browser new tab into a distraction-free notepad
products.summaryZh: 将浏览器新标签页变成无干扰的记事本
products.descriptionZh: Tab Notes将每个新浏览器标签页变成一个无干扰的记事本。通过富文本、表格和语法高亮代码块即时捕捉想法，或使用内置形状画布绘制思路。完全离线运行，支持本地存储，或私密同步至个人Google Drive，无服务器锁定。可在全屏标签页中访问笔记，通过快速工具栏弹窗覆盖任意网站，并随时导出为txt或md格式。
products.description: Tab Notes turns every new browser tab into a distraction-free notepad. Capture thoughts instantly with rich text, tables, and syntax-highlighted code blocks, or sketch ideas using the built-in shape canvas. Works completely offline with local storage or syncs privately to your personal Google Drive with zero server lock-in. Access notes in full-screen tabs, via a quick toolbar popup over any website, and export totxt ormd anytime.

products.name: Yattayo
products.tagline: A physical slider to-do board, faithfully rebuilt in 3D
products.summaryZh: 实体滑动待办看板，以3D形式忠实重建
products.descriptionZh: Yattayo是一款能让你感受到的待办事项列表。每个任务都是橙色板上的真实3D滑块——拖动旋钮，听到棘轮咔嗒声，一个“OK”印章就会落在上面。完成。• 每个任务都是一张便利贴。点击它，直接在纸上手写或打字 • 滑动完成的便签，将其从板上撕下 • 用手指旋转整个板子 • 小组件显示真实板面——无需打开应用即可滑动开关 • iPhone、Apple Watch和Mac，通过iCloud同步。最多免费使用3个任务。
products.description: Yattayo is a to-do list you can feel. Every task is a real 3D slider on an orange board — drag the knob, hear the ratchet click, and an "OK" stamp lands on it. Done. • Every task is a sticky note. Tap it and handwrite or type right on the paper • Swipe a finished note to peel it off the board • Spin the whole board around with your finger • Widgets show the real board — slide the switch without opening the app • iPhone, Apple Watch and Mac, synced over iCloud Free for up to 3 tasks.

products.name: Local Music Organizer for Mac
products.tagline: Ultimate toolkit for local Apple Music library maintenance
products.summaryZh: Apple Music本地资料库维护终极工具箱
products.descriptionZh: 本地音乐整理器是一款专为大型本地音乐收藏设计的原生macOS工具。它兼容Music.app资料库和独立音频文件，无需Apple Music订阅。可查找重复和缺失文件、比较播放列表、检查元数据、识别可疑的升频和转码、查看频谱和波形，并离线修复或转换罕见格式。你的音乐始终留在Mac上。所有功能免费试用3天，之后一次购买即可解锁。无订阅。
products.description: Local Music Organizer is a native macOS toolkit built for large local music collections. It works with Music.app libraries and standalone audio files, with no Apple Music subscription required. Find duplicates and missing files, compare playlists, inspect metadata, detect suspicious upscales and transcodes, view spectra and waveforms, and repair or convert rare formats offline. Your music stays on your Mac. Try every feature free for 3 days, then unlock it with one purchase. No subscription.

products.name: ANCBuddy for Bose QC Ultra
products.tagline: Control Bose QC Ultra from your macOS menu bar
products.summaryZh: 从macOS菜单栏控制Bose QC Ultra
products.descriptionZh: ANCBuddy将Bose QuietComfort Ultra设备的ANC模式和电池状态集成到macOS菜单栏中，让你无需打开其他应用即可切换模式和查看电量。提供免费试用；专为通勤者和专注优先的工作流程设计。欢迎macOS上的QC Ultra用户提供反馈。
products.description: ANCBuddy puts ANC mode and battery status for Bose QuietComfort Ultra devices into the macOS menu bar so you can toggle modes and monitor battery without opening another app. Free trial available; designed for commuters and focus-first workflows. Looking for feedback from QC Ultra users on macOS.

products.name: Oppora AI
products.tagline: Find Leads, Run Outreach, and Book Meetings on Autopilot
products.summaryZh: 自动寻找潜在客户、开展外联并自动预订会议
products.descriptionZh: Oppora是一套AI销售系统，能将您的ICP转化为自动运行的外向型工作流程。查找并丰富决策者信息，对线索进行评分，个性化电子邮件和LinkedIn外联，保护送达率，处理回复，安排会议，并将合格机会同步至您的CRM。无需拼接数据库、丰富化、发送、预热、收件箱和CRM工具，只需构建一次工作流程，让Oppora持续运行。
products.description: Oppora is an AI sales system that turns your ICP into a self-running outbound workflow. Find and enrich decision-makers, score leads, personalize email and LinkedIn outreach, protect deliverability, handle replies, book meetings, and sync qualified opportunities to your CRM. Instead of stitching together databases, enrichment, sending, warm-up, inbox, and CRM tools, build one workflow once and let Oppora keep it running.

products.name: OPENBOT
products.tagline: Opensource alternative for Grokbot
products.summaryZh: Grokbot的开源替代品
products.descriptionZh: 大多数代理工具提供的只是一个会重置的聊天框。OPENBOT则为你提供队友：有名字、长期存在的代理，它们拥有自己的对话、记忆和日程安排，共享一台带有浏览器、终端和文件系统的持久计算机。你像与同事一样给Bot发消息。它会在实际工具中完成工作，通过MCP连接器（若存在）或浏览器（若无连接器）进行操作，并在需要你批准时返回。
products.description: Most agent tooling gives you a chat box that resets. OPENBOT gives you teammates: named, long-lived agents with their own conversation, memory and schedule, sharing one persistent computer with a browser, a shell and a filesystem. You message a Bot like a colleague. It does the work in the actual tools, through MCP where a connector exists and through the browser where one does not, and comes back when it needs your approval.

products.name: DailyOutbid.lol
products.tagline: Another outbid.lol copycat, but leaderboard resets EVERY 24h
products.summaryZh: 又一个outbid.lol的仿冒品，但排行榜每24小时重置一次。
products.descriptionZh: 付费参与排名，午夜重置。这是一个每日付费排行榜，1美元即可参与：出价超过竞争对手，登顶榜首，并保留一个永久的dofollow反向链接。
products.description: Pay to rank. Resets at midnight. A daily pay-to-rank leaderboard where $1 gets you started: outbid competitors, top the board, and keep a permanent dofollow backlink.

products.name: asktube.xyz
products.tagline: AI for YouTube power users
products.summaryZh: 面向YouTube重度用户的AI工具
products.descriptionZh: 你亲手搭建了自己的YouTube资料库——主题播放列表、为日后所需保存的视频、选择关注的频道。这是你精心整理的知识花园。然而当你有问题时，YouTube却无法跨这些内容进行搜索。它的AI只能从你正在观看的单个视频中寻找答案。真的吗？asktube是为YouTube重度用户打造的AI：像搜索自己的文件一样，跨你关注的所有频道和播放列表进行搜索和提问。YouTube的AI只看到单个视频；asktube看到的是你构建的整个资料库。
products.description: You hand-built your YouTube library — topic playlists, videos saved for when you'd need them, channels you chose to follow. Your curated knowledge garden. Then you have a question, and YouTube can't search across any of it. Its AI answers from the one video you're watching. Really? asktube is the AI for YouTube power users: search and ask across every channel and playlist you follow, the way you search your own files. YouTube's AI sees one video; asktube sees the library you built.

products.name: OverMCP
products.tagline: The market for builders.
products.summaryZh: 建筑商市场。
products.descriptionZh: 发现产品，追踪真实点击，竞逐透明实时排行榜榜首。
products.description: Discover products, follow real clicks, and bid for the top spot on a transparent live leaderboard.

products.name: Scrollytelling
products.tagline: Immersive storytelling with AI. No design skills required.
products.summaryZh: AI驱动的沉浸式叙事，无需设计技能。
products.descriptionZh: 只需与AI对话，即可构建高端滚动叙事页面。沉浸式、电影感、由滚动驱动的故事，通常需要工作室数周时间，如今几分钟内完成并即时加载。美观与速度兼得，无需取舍。互联网充斥着千篇一律的静态AI文本。滚动叙事页面脱颖而出，让读者驻足阅读而非跳过。从模板开始，嵌入即用型交互组件，通过AI或手动精调，一键发布。
products.description: Build high-end scrollytelling pages just by chatting with AI. Immersive, cinematic, scroll-driven stories, the kind that usually take a studio weeks, built in minutes and loading instantly. No trade-off between beautiful and fast. The internet is drowning in static AI text that all looks the same. Scrollytelling pages stand out and keep people reading instead of skipping. Start from a template, drop in ready-to-use interactive widgets, refine with AI or by hand, and publish in one click.

products.name: Aximote
products.tagline: Your car data, finally in your pocket
products.summaryZh: 你的车辆数据，终于尽在掌握。
products.descriptionZh: Aximote将您的汽车数据同步至iPhone，让每一次驾驶都变得清晰可解。行程自动呈现，涵盖油耗、充电、费用及驾驶效率等洞察。您可自定义仪表盘，展示20余项车辆指标，对比行程与长期趋势，管理多辆汽车，并保持连续驾驶历史——即使更换品牌也不中断。无需额外硬件。
products.description: Aximote brings the data from your car to your iPhone and turns every drive into something you can understand. Trips appear automatically with insights into consumption, charging, costs and driving efficiency. Customize a dashboard with 20+ vehicle metrics, compare trips and long-term trends, manage multiple cars, and keep one continuous driving history—even when you switch brands. No additional hardware required.

products.name: KanaSensei
products.tagline: Read Japanese kana in two weeks
products.summaryZh: 两周内学会阅读日语假名
products.descriptionZh: KanaSensei是一款用于学习阅读日语的网页应用。通过自适应练习、挑战、易记助记符、母语音频和进度追踪，练习平假名和片假名。
products.description: KanaSensei is a web app for learning to read Japanese. Practice hiragana and katakana with adaptive drills, challenges, memorable mnemonics, native audio, and progress tracking.

products.name: Flown
products.tagline: Every flight you've ever taken, on one private map
products.summaryZh: 你乘坐过的每一次航班，都汇聚在一张私人地图上。
products.descriptionZh: 你乘坐过的每一次航班，都绘制在一张地图上。打卡197个国家，收集护照印章，回顾你在空中的一年。当航班延误，航空公司应赔偿你220至520英镑时，Flown会帮你计算并告知。数据在设备上处理，无需账户。
products.description: Every flight you've ever taken, drawn on one map. Tick off 197 countries, collect passport stamps, see your year in the air. And when a late flight means the airline owes you £220-£520, Flown works it out and tells you. On-device, no account.

products.name: Comu Action Pro
products.tagline: Your pocket-sized Al workmate
products.summaryZh: 你的口袋AI工作伙伴
products.descriptionZh: Comu是你口袋里的AI工作伙伴，将对话转化为行动。轻松记录会议、访谈和想法，并即刻将其转换为后续邮件、行动清单、演示文稿、摘要等。无需提示，无需复杂流程。只需开口，工作即可完成。
products.description: Comu is your pocket-sized AI workmate that turns conversations into action. Record meetings, interviews, and ideas with ease, then instantly transform them into follow-up emails, action lists, presentations, summaries, and more. No prompts, no complicated workflows. Just talk, and get work done.
